caption: The drawing depicts two pairs of metallic scissors-like objects, both with ornate, curled handles resembling antique candle snuffers or wick trimmers. The upper object is positioned with its pointed ends open and the handles below, colored in rusty brown tones with visible texture indicating age. The lower object lies flat, closed, and placed on an intricately designed, grayish-silver tray with decorative edges and details, showing a small box-like compartment on one blade. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition is simple, with the upper object centered above the tray and the lower object placed horizontally across the tray.
title: Pewter Tray and Snuffers
